item.text: The campaign is live from midnight Johannesburg time, January 5, with a $100 lifetime cap and a $7.69 daily pace over 13 days. It excludes China, uses all Twitter placements worldwide, and promotes four of your approved posts; each is accepted. The fifth post is the generic “Something new” version, so I left it out in favor of the four that state the EP and streaming offer. I’ll check delivery and adjust during the flight.

Day one delivered 56,363 impressions and 37 link clicks for $7.15. Among the four promoted posts, the “fresh-start” copy led with 19 clicks; the “Small resolutions” and “One More Morning” copy each generated 5. That’s too little data for a reliable winner yet, and the campaign is spending within pace, so I’m leaving the setup as is and continuing daily checks. The clicks are landing-page visits; stream opens remain unmeasured.

The campaign continues to pace near $7/day. Through January 9 Johannesburg time, the post-level data shows “Keep that fresh-start feeling moving” still leading on clicks per impression (82/82,869); “Small resolutions” and “Free through January 17” are behind. X doesn’t provide a safe way here to rebalance individual posts within the active ad group, so I’m keeping the $100 cap intact and tracking whether the lead persists.

item.text:
The X campaign ran for the full 13 days, from January 5 through January 17 in Johannesburg time, and is now paused.

- **Spend:** $98.07 of the $100 budget
- **Impressions:** 731,384
- **Link clicks:** 484

Those 484 clicks are visits from the ads to your landing page. They do **not** tell us how many people opened the EP on Sivro Stream; without X’s pixel or another stream event measurement, that number is unknown.
